newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 5.09 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 91-day bills average accepted yield 5.09 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 91-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's weekly tender was 5.09 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with three-month HIBOR of 5.54167 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 5.12 percent at the previous tender on October 8.
Bids for the HK$1.50 billion issue was HK$11.43 billion versus HK$8.15 billion last week. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6369
